title: The Eltingville Club
creator: Dorkin, Evan
contributors: Allie, Scott and Chabon, Daniel(Editors); Dyre, Sarah (Colors, 'Compter Chops'); McKenzie, Christina (Digital Art Technician); Thome, Brennan (Collection Designer)
description: A hardback containing the entire 'Eltingville Club' comic series. The experiences of four late teen boys living in Eltingville, New Jersey representing the worst aspects of the phenomenon of Fandoms in their self-made club called The Eltingville Comic Book, Science-Fiction, Fantasy, Horror and Role-Playing Club. Makes multiple shoutouts and references to existing franchises and artists, including science fiction comic illustrator Wallace "Wally" Woods and high fantasy comic series Elfquest. First release in 1994, completing the series in 2015. Edition includes a final  send-off letter from Evan Dorkin, concerpt art and commentary from the television adaptation pilot and a short comic called 'The Northwest Comic Collective', simiar characters part of the underground comic sector. First Edition

description: A memoir from 1978 Jonestown Massacre survivor Laura Johnson Kohl, from her first introduction to the infamous Reverend James Warren Jones, aka Jim Jones to the day of the November 18 1978 massacre. Included is a business card with the author's contacts and online handles at the time of recieving the book.
